files.workspace.css: .list-workspace{font:14px system-ui;max-width:900px;padding:20px}.list-workspace header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.list-workspace button{font:inherit;padding:8px 12px;min-height:40px}.list-workspace button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2457c5;outline-offset:2px}.list-error{padding:16px;border:2px solid #a73030;border-radius:6px;margin:16px 0}.list-workspace ul{padding:0;list-style:none}.list-workspace li{border-bottom:1px solid #ccd2dc;padding:8px 0}.empty{padding:32px;border:1px dashed #7e8999;text-align:center}
